groups.title: Carrots
items: 1kg of whole carrots, washed and peeled (about 8-12 carrots)
Olive oil, to coat the carrots before smoking

groups.title: Glaze - Optional
items: ¼ cup peach preserves (or orange marmalade)

steps: Prepare the Smoker & Carrots Preheat the Kamado to 225 °F. Place the carrots in a bowl or on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil, and toss to coat. Sprinkle the ginger powder, garlic powder, and salt over the carrots and toss again to evenly season.
Smoke the Carrots Place the seasoned carrots directly on the grill grate of your smoker. Smoke at 225 °F for 2–3 hours, until the carrots are tender when pierced with a fork.

Make the Glaze (optional) In a small microwave-safe bowl, combine peach preserves, butter, and lemon juice. Microwave in short intervals (for example, 15 seconds) until melted and blended into a smooth glaze.
Finish & Serve Remove the smoked carrots from the smoker and place them in a large bowl. Drizzle the glaze over the carrots and gently toss to coat. Serve warm as a smoky, sweet side dish.
